items.title: Sound plays when inbound DM arrives off-thread
items.precondition: Two mutuals signed in; B on Feed (or any page except /messages/:thatConversationId); sockets connected; sounds enabled; B has clicked once after sign-in (unlock)
steps: Confirm B Account Settings → Play notification sounds is on
A sends a text message to B
items.expected: B hears the message notification sound promptly via message:new.
items.notes: useMessageNotificationSound listens for MESSAGE_NEW in AppShell; playNotificationSound('message') when off-thread.
items.waiver: Two-browser interactive verify deferred to PR author on local Vite 5180.

items.title: No sound when already in the open thread
items.precondition: Same as A1; B has conversation with A open at /messages/:conversationId
steps: A sends another message while B stays on that thread
items.expected: Message appears in thread but no notification sound plays.

items.title: Autoplay unlock after first interaction
items.precondition: Fresh sign-in session; sounds enabled; socket connected
steps: Before any click, have A send a message — expect silence (blocked)
A sends again while B is off-thread
items.expected: Second message plays sound after unlock interaction.
items.notes: pointerdown/keydown calls unlockNotificationSounds(); silent play at volume 0 sets isUnlocked.
items.waiver: Browser autoplay behavior varies; interactive verify deferred to PR.

items.title: Mute toggle blocks and restores sounds
steps: Turn off Play notification sounds in Account Settings
A sends a message — no sound
items.expected: localStorage preference gates playback; survives page refresh.
items.notes: AccountSettingsPage checkbox writes socmed.sounds.enabled via setNotificationSoundsEnabled.

items.title: Own messages never play sound
steps: Send a message from B to A while B is on inbox list or another page
items.expected: No sound for outbound messages (senderId === self).
items.notes: Hook returns early when msg.senderId === user.id.

items.title: Typecheck / build
items.expected: Both succeed with no errors caused by this plan.
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: npm run typecheck and npm run build succeeded on kylie/message-notification-features.

items.title: No backend or migration changes
steps: Confirm no edits under src/ services, routes, or database/migrations for this feature
items.evidence: 2026-08-01: changes limited to frontend/public/sounds, frontend/src/lib, hooks, AppShell, AccountSettingsPage, and plans/.
